title: To Be Together/Quotes
summary:
"We really must stop meeting like this."
- Montehue to Dante Vale after saving his life from Chemosh

"What's the point of being king or queen if you can't do whatever you want." (Lok Lambert on King Solomon and Queen Sheba)

"Love is seldom simple, Lok." (Sophie Casterwill)

"How quickly the kids grow up these days..."
- Cherit as Lok and Sophie almost confess their feelings to each other

"Man, you've got some timing, you know that?"
- Lok Lambert sarcastically to Tersly after he interrupted Lok confessing his feelings to Sophie

"Sophie, I- I've been trying to tell you for a while, but I'm not really very good at this." (Lok Lambert)

"Lok, I will listen to anything you have to say." (Sophie Casterwill)

"Sophie, I know we're both from different worlds, sorta like Solomon and Sheba, but I don't want us to end up like them... never having the chance to be together." (Lok Lambert)

"Enjoy the view, Professor, 'cause this is as close as you're gonna get."
- Dante Vale on the Amulet of Will before tossing it to Lok Lambert

"He's come a long way, that boy."
- Cherit on Lok Lambert after he acquired Tao's ring

"Sir, they still have Behemoth in reserve. We cannot win unless you use it." (Rassimov on the Professor invoking Araknos)

"Now is not the time. We will fight them, and win, but on my terms, not these." (The Professor)
